description: This file contains the implementation of the LowOrderFee class, which is a model extension for calculating the low order fee within the OpenCart e-commerce system. It extends the base Model class and defines a method getTotal to add a fee if certain conditions are met.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: Represents a model extension for calculating low order fee in the checkout process.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds a low order fee to the total if the cart subtotal is below a configured threshold. It updates the totals and taxes arrays accordingly.
